title: Powerless
author: Lauren Roberts
summary: In a kingdom where people with powers rule and those without are treated as lesser, a girl without any powers survives as a pickpocket. She is pulled into a deadly trial and a complicated attraction to two brothers.
readIf: you want a quick, YA romantasy with a lot of tension, a love triangle and a deadly contest.
skipIf: you want more complex worldbuilding or are tired of love triangles and rivals-to-lovers.

pairings.reason: Another society-spanning contest story with a fierce young heroine and a gap between rich and poor.
A very similar premise of a powerless girl hiding among the powerful, with shifting loyalties.
Another young-adult fantasy with a tournament, a court and a love triangle.
